digest: 早上好 ☀️ 今天是 2026-10-27。以下是为你汇总的早报内容。

items.title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: How Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows, Daybreak to strengthen security, and Codex to reduce rework.

items.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
items.summary: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics—and how researchers can verify and build on them.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol to investigate security risks across complex codebases. Its security agent helps developers review findings and proposed fixes.

items.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
items.summary: Explore OpenAI Signals data on 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how people use ChatGPT for work and how usage changes over time.

items.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
items.summary: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.
